source: NoodleExtensions SpawnDataManager.cs, NoteInitNoodlifier.cs, NoteFloorMovementNoodlifier.cs, NoteJumpNoodlifier.cs, NoteUpdateNoodlifier.cs, Animation/AnimationHelper.cs, ObjectProcessing/ProcessNotesNoodleDataInTimeRow.cs @ 3bbcaf6733f6faa688a70b296b4d83c92c1f5dc8
frame: Unity: +x right, +y up, +z away from the player; origin at the play-space centre on the floor. world = worldRotation' * local (the transform's localPosition). Godot: (x, y, -z), quaternion (-x, -y, z, w).
reconstruction: The flip x easing (InOutQuad over the first quarter), the flip y bump (0.5 - 0.5 cos(8 pi s)) and the 0.45 / 0.15 heights are ArcViewer's reconstruction of NoteJump; Noodle quotes only `localPosition.y += num3 * yAvoidance`. The end distance offset after three quarters of the jump is not modelled (unknown). transform_rotation is the NoteController's rotation: the arrow's roll and look rotation are on the child cube and are not included.
